description: Vue.js component for media thumbnail container, handling display, sorting, and actions for media items in a media field editor.

methods.name: initSortable
methods.description: Initializes sortable functionality for media items if allowMultiple is true.

methods.name: selectAndDeleteMedia
methods.description: Emits event to request deletion of selected media.

methods.name: selectMedia
methods.description: Emits event to request selection of a media item.

methods.name: buildMediaUrl
methods.description: Constructs media URL with size parameters.

methods.name: getfontAwesomeClassNameForFileName
methods.description: Returns Font Awesome class name based on filename and size.
